name: Aarhus University
header:
Aarhus University
Denmark · MSc Mathematics; flexible4+4 and post-master5+3 PhD
European research-fit addition; direct four-year US-bachelor equivalence requires individual confirmation.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• MSc requires 10ECTS programming in addition to broad mathematics.
• A four-year US bachelor does not automatically establish4+4 PhD eligibility.
• Pending UChicago degree is not a confirmed English-test exemption by January 15.
• Natural Sciences MSc scholarship is tuition only, without a living stipend.
• PhD form cannot save a partial draft; letters and all PDFs must be ready before submission.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: UChicago bachelor may qualify if equivalent to a Danish180-ECTS degree and containing60 ECTS broad
mathematics plus10 ECTS programming. Programming is a genuine separate prerequisite; do not assume the
math major alone satisfies it. PhD: current flexible4+4 route requires bachelor plus at least60 ECTS additional
master-level study; a four-year US bachelor is not automatically declared equivalent. Seek assessment of
graduate courses beyond bachelor requirements. Ordinary5+3 PhD requires master-level qualification. [s1] [s13]
[s14]
Before submission [Standing rule]
MSc: check programming and mathematical prerequisites; gather official syllabi, records, English proof and fee
receipt; rank up to three programmes. PhD: discuss project and funding with a prospective adviser, prepare
every attachment before opening the form - the PhD form cannot be saved partially for later. Separate
general-project and advertised-project applications have distinct research-description content. [s1] [s5] [s6] [s12]
[s16]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Strongly recommended for PhD general call and mathematics programme: discuss a targeted project and
available financing. Main supervisor must be permanent scientific staff at least
associate-professor/senior-researcher level. MSc does not require a prearranged thesis supervisor. Current
matches below do not imply an advertised 2027 vacancy. [s1] [s12] [s16] [s18]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
MSc DANS portal: rank up to three programmes, upload each complete file, submit and check Messages
receipt; only one offer is made and lower priorities then rejected. Request reopening for missing documents,
not email attachments. PhD: complete in one browser session, cannot save partial draft; submit all required
PDFs and retain confirmation/applicationID. [s6] [s7] [s8] [s12]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
MSc summer 2027 portal-delay notice and timeline are explicit. Tuition table is 2026-27; PhD income examples
mix 2024/2026 and undated amounts. PhD quarterly schedule is standing, with specific 2027 projects not all
announced. November 2026 round already closed. [s2] [s3] [s10] [s12] [s13] [s14] [s17]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
MSc summer 2027 non-EU: January 15, 2027, midnightCET under the current timeline; submit before 23:59 to
avoid boundary ambiguity. Portal opening was postponed from November 1 to November 5, 2026. PhD
recurring rounds: February 1, May 1, August 1 and November 1, 23:59 localCET/CEST, opening two months
before. International candidates wanting August-October start must apply by May 1 at latest (four-month lead
time), or an earlier round. Specific 2027 project availability is not yet guaranteed. [s2] [s3] [s12]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
MSc automatic Danish state tuition-waiver consideration: January 15 for summer admission; no separate
application. PhD funding is assessed with the chosen call, same deadline. November 1, 2026 round is closed;
February 1, 2027 or May 1, 2027 are standing prospective rounds suitable for later start, subject to
eligibility/project availability. [s11] [s12] [s17]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
PhD: all references must be PDF attachments in the portal before the application deadline; late documents are
expressly excluded. No grace period. MSc ordinary mathematics checklist does not request letters. [s5] [s12]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
MSc English tests or qualifying educational credentials must be passed no later than January 15; the timeline
distinguishes this from later final-bachelor documentation. PhD English evidence can be requested at any
stage of recruitment; no universal advance test-report deadline is stated. No GRE deadline. [s3] [s4] [s12]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
MSc upload academic records/course descriptions and fee receipt with application. National ID due April 1;
completed bachelor diploma due July 1 for non-EU summer entrants. Conditional offers specify missing items
and document reopening; documents cannot be emailed. PhD: complete records, proposal, CV, motivation and
references before deadline; pending master diploma sent promptly once earned if applying for post-master
entry. [s3] [s5] [s7] [s8] [s12]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
MSc standing/current timeline: accept conditional or full offer by April 1; scholarship offers can have a shorter
deadline in the letter. Tuition invoice gives individual payment deadline, generally April-May, before
residence-permit paperwork. PhD offer response date is individual; February round decisions endMarch, May
round endJune, August round endSeptember, November round earlyJanuary. [s3] [s11] [s12]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc EnglishB: IELTS6.5 overall/6 each; legacy TOEFL83/20 each; new-scale TOEFL4.5 overall/4 each;
Cambridge qualifying certificates. TOEFL/IELTS must be no more than two years old when the application portal
opens. No Duolingo/PTE, TOEFLMyBest/Essentials/ITP or IELTSOneSkillRetake. PhD expects fluent academic
English comparable to TOEFL83/IELTS6.5 and may request proof during recruitment. [s4] [s12]
UChicago English exemption [Unresolved]
A completed English-taught bachelor/master from the USA qualifies for MSc educational exemption, with
medium-of-instruction evidence. Because the page says completed and the timeline says English qualifications
must be passed by January 15, the pending UChicago degree is NOT a confirmed waiver route for a senior-year
application. Ask admissions before relying on it, or obtain a valid test by the deadline. PhD does not state an
automatic UChicago exemption from any requested evidence. [s3] [s4] [s12]
GRE General [Standing rule]
No GRE General requirement or recommendation in the mathematics MSc requirements or GSNS PhD guide. No
public permission/weight for unsolicited scores was established. [s1] [s5] [s12]

guide. [s1] [s5] [s12]

Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
MSc: official bachelor diploma if complete, current official transcript otherwise; course titles, grades, credits,
name; official grading scale with lowest passing/highest grade; current-course registration and study-abroad
records where relevant. PhD: all relevant bachelor/master diplomas and transcripts, originals plus certified

calculated using original credits, not converted ECTS; upload calculation PDF and optional class rank. [s5] [s12]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
MSc transcript and ongoing-course documentation plus descriptions for all passed/current courses. PhD
weighted-GPA worksheet in Other information to consider; official templates accommodate35 or75 non-ECTS
courses. Distinguish bachelor and master GPA; no independent fixed20-course list. [s5] [s12]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
MSc required for all completed/current courses; official descriptions may be assembled into a document with
direct institutional URL after each, or institution-stamped/signed. Self-translation is allowed with originals
enclosed. PhD does not universally require a separate syllabus packet, though additional verification can be
requested. [s5] [s12]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
PhD minimum one reference; additional relevant references permitted. MSc ordinary mathematics checklist
lists none. [s5] [s12]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
MSc tuition waiver uses ordinary admission materials and explicitly asks for no additional documents. PhD
reference is part of the funded application. Optional official template asks relationship/duration, comparative
ratings for qualifications, maturity, creativity, motivation and intellectual potential, plus brief
evaluation/signature/date. [s11] [s12] [s15]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
PhD public guide directs applicant to gather references as PDF uploads; it does not describe automatic
invitations from entered referee details. Obtain the letter or agree a confidential alternative with GSNS before
the deadline. MSc has no ordinary referee workflow. [s5] [s12]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
PhD references are required before final application submission; the guide does not provide a post-submit
invitation process or extra deadline. [s12]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
PhD final submission generates email confirmation with applicationID; this is not a separately documented
referee-receipt dashboard. Since the public workflow uses applicant uploads, verify the attached referencePDF
before sending. MSc confirmation is in portal Messages with email notification. [s6] [s12]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
PhD explicitly permits previously obtained reference letters to be uploaded. No guaranteed post-submission
replacement control was established; late documents excluded. If duplicate applications for the same project
are submitted, GSNS may evaluate only the latest. MSc submitted content cannot be edited freely; reopening
is for requested missing documents. [s8] [s12]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
PhD requires updated CV covering education, experience and accomplishments; no page cap specified. MSc
ordinary mathematics checklist has no CV requirement; live form may ask structured biographical details. PhD
attachments PDF, maximum 20MB each category, merge multiple items per category; no ZIP. [s5] [s12]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
PhD exact short prompt: “Explain your reasons for applying.” Maximum one page. No specified font/spacing.
This motivation is distinct from the project description. No MSc mathematics SOP listed. [s1] [s5] [s12]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background essay listed for ordinary MSc or PhD. Relevant circumstances can be
addressed in PhD motivation within one page or in a specifically requested administrative explanation. [s5] [s12]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
PhD general call incorporates interests into project description and named supervisor discussion. No additional
standalone interest essay. Specific calls may instruct copying their advertised project text into the required
proposal upload; follow that call. [s12] [s17]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
PhD general call:0.5-4 pages describing project ideas and research plans; may link further information. Adviser
discussion strongly recommended but committee can match an independently proposed project. Specific-call
instructions govern its proposal upload. No MSc research proposal listed. [s5] [s12] [s17]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
GSNS may remove scientific papers, large reports and theses from uploads; provide a URL instead. If seeking
credit for earlier research, documented written evidence may be required under the specific credit-transfer
rules. No ordinary MSc thesis/sample requirement. [s5] [s12] [s14]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Include research accomplishments/publications in PhD CV where relevant; link full papers instead of uploading
large manuscripts. No separate publication-list cap or mandatory publication requirement. MSc has no listed
publication document. [s5] [s12]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
MSc full course descriptions and ongoing-course records; PhD GPA-calculationPDF with original credits. No
additional generic mathematics-course essay or bespoke form was established. [s5] [s12]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
MSc Danish state scholarship: no separate application, essay or extra upload; explicit instruction not to add
scholarship documents. PhD funding explanation asks sources/amounts of any available support; may be blank
for a specific funded call. [s11] [s12]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
PhD: desired start, credit-transfer request, financing where applicable, chosen call/project title and how you
heard of the call; name-change proof if records differ. All material English or Danish, preferably English.
PDF20MB maximum, no ZIP; precise text-field character limits are not public. [s12]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Conflict]
MSc: no living stipend guaranteed. Natural Sciences scholarships are100% tuition waivers only; typically one or
two awards/programme, competitive. Mathematics tuition 2026-27 is EUR17300/year;2027-28 not published.
PhD4+4 PartA: DKK14852/month before tax at 2026 level, arithmetic DKK178224/year, plus optional paid
student-teaching work. Salaried phase sources conflict: approximately DKK30000/month in one paragraph
versus28000 elsewhere (annual arithmetic360000 or336000 gross, excluding pension/holiday). Neither is a
verified 2027 contract rate. [s10] [s11] [s13] [s14]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc tuition waiver tied to named two-year programme; precise continuation terms in award letter. Flexible4+4
normally four years with master/qualifying exam after two, then two salaried years; credits can shorten
duration. Post-master5+3 fellowship up to three years, adjusted for approved prior work. [s11] [s13] [s14]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Tuition-liable non-EU applicants can receive MSc state waivers. International applicants can compete for PhD
positions, subject to qualification and funded plan. Separate ordinary Danish SU entitlement is not implied by
PhD-SU scholarship eligibility or US F-1 status. [s11] [s12] [s13]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
PhD admission depends on a complete plan covering scholarship/salary, tuition, research and mobility.
Published tuition DKK80000/year normally comes from funding. Personal/private self-funding is prohibited;
externally awarded scholarships require approval and research-freedom review. Salaried fellows normally
owe280 hours/year academic work, with one semester exempt; negotiated removal reduces pay. PartA
student-teacher employment is optional. [s12] [s13] [s14]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
MSc scholarship automatically considered with admission. PhD choose general call with own project and
funding discussion, or a specific already-funded project; each project requires its own application. Academic
eligibility alone does not secure a funded place. [s11] [s12]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Approved external foundation/EU/home-country scholarship or industrial employer support can form a doctoral
plan; international scholarship contracts are assessed for research freedom. Industrial PhD requires separate
company funding application plus GSNS conditional approval. No universally available additional 2027 award
for a new UChicago mathematics graduate was established. [s12] [s14]
Application fee [Standing rule]
MSc EUR150/DKK1125 application fee, covers up to three AU programmes; pay through webshop by deadline
and attach receipt to each. Refunded if offer accepted and still enrolled October 1 (summer) or March 1
(winter); not refunded on rejection. PhD GSNS application explicitly free. [s9] [s12]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
MSc exemptions: Danish bachelor, tuition-exempt status, or living in Denmark at time of application under the
published rule. US F-1/UChicago does not itself qualify. No general need-based application waiver established.
PhD no fee, hence no waiver needed. [s9] [s12]

Aarhus University
Denmark · MSc Mathematics; flexible4+4 and post-master5+3 PhD
European research-fit addition; direct four-year US-bachelor equivalence requires individual confirmation.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• MSc requires 10ECTS programming in addition to broad mathematics.
• A four-year US bachelor does not automatically establish4+4 PhD eligibility.
• Pending UChicago degree is not a confirmed English-test exemption by January 15.
• Natural Sciences MSc scholarship is tuition only, without a living stipend.
• PhD form cannot save a partial draft; letters and all PDFs must be ready before submission.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: UChicago bachelor may qualify if equivalent to a Danish180-ECTS degree and containing60 ECTS broad
mathematics plus10 ECTS programming. Programming is a genuine separate prerequisite; do not assume the
math major alone satisfies it. PhD: current flexible4+4 route requires bachelor plus at least60 ECTS additional
master-level study; a four-year US bachelor is not automatically declared equivalent. Seek assessment of
graduate courses beyond bachelor requirements. Ordinary5+3 PhD requires master-level qualification. [s1] [s13]
[s14]
Before submission [Standing rule]
MSc: check programming and mathematical prerequisites; gather official syllabi, records, English proof and fee
receipt; rank up to three programmes. PhD: discuss project and funding with a prospective adviser, prepare
every attachment before opening the form - the PhD form cannot be saved partially for later. Separate
general-project and advertised-project applications have distinct research-description content. [s1] [s5] [s6] [s12]
[s16]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Strongly recommended for PhD general call and mathematics programme: discuss a targeted project and
available financing. Main supervisor must be permanent scientific staff at least
associate-professor/senior-researcher level. MSc does not require a prearranged thesis supervisor. Current
matches below do not imply an advertised 2027 vacancy. [s1] [s12] [s16] [s18]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
MSc DANS portal: rank up to three programmes, upload each complete file, submit and check Messages
receipt; only one offer is made and lower priorities then rejected. Request reopening for missing documents,
not email attachments. PhD: complete in one browser session, cannot save partial draft; submit all required
PDFs and retain confirmation/applicationID. [s6] [s7] [s8] [s12]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
MSc summer 2027 portal-delay notice and timeline are explicit. Tuition table is 2026-27; PhD income examples
mix 2024/2026 and undated amounts. PhD quarterly schedule is standing, with specific 2027 projects not all
announced. November 2026 round already closed. [s2] [s3] [s10] [s12] [s13] [s14] [s17]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
MSc summer 2027 non-EU: January 15, 2027, midnightCET under the current timeline; submit before 23:59 to
avoid boundary ambiguity. Portal opening was postponed from November 1 to November 5, 2026. PhD
recurring rounds: February 1, May 1, August 1 and November 1, 23:59 localCET/CEST, opening two months
before. International candidates wanting August-October start must apply by May 1 at latest (four-month lead
time), or an earlier round. Specific 2027 project availability is not yet guaranteed. [s2] [s3] [s12]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
MSc automatic Danish state tuition-waiver consideration: January 15 for summer admission; no separate
application. PhD funding is assessed with the chosen call, same deadline. November 1, 2026 round is closed;
February 1, 2027 or May 1, 2027 are standing prospective rounds suitable for later start, subject to
eligibility/project availability. [s11] [s12] [s17]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
PhD: all references must be PDF attachments in the portal before the application deadline; late documents are
expressly excluded. No grace period. MSc ordinary mathematics checklist does not request letters. [s5] [s12]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
MSc English tests or qualifying educational credentials must be passed no later than January 15; the timeline
distinguishes this from later final-bachelor documentation. PhD English evidence can be requested at any
stage of recruitment; no universal advance test-report deadline is stated. No GRE deadline. [s3] [s4] [s12]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
MSc upload academic records/course descriptions and fee receipt with application. National ID due April 1;
completed bachelor diploma due July 1 for non-EU summer entrants. Conditional offers specify missing items
and document reopening; documents cannot be emailed. PhD: complete records, proposal, CV, motivation and
references before deadline; pending master diploma sent promptly once earned if applying for post-master
entry. [s3] [s5] [s7] [s8] [s12]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
MSc standing/current timeline: accept conditional or full offer by April 1; scholarship offers can have a shorter
deadline in the letter. Tuition invoice gives individual payment deadline, generally April-May, before
residence-permit paperwork. PhD offer response date is individual; February round decisions endMarch, May
round endJune, August round endSeptember, November round earlyJanuary. [s3] [s11] [s12]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc EnglishB: IELTS6.5 overall/6 each; legacy TOEFL83/20 each; new-scale TOEFL4.5 overall/4 each;
Cambridge qualifying certificates. TOEFL/IELTS must be no more than two years old when the application portal
opens. No Duolingo/PTE, TOEFLMyBest/Essentials/ITP or IELTSOneSkillRetake. PhD expects fluent academic
English comparable to TOEFL83/IELTS6.5 and may request proof during recruitment. [s4] [s12]
UChicago English exemption [Unresolved]
A completed English-taught bachelor/master from the USA qualifies for MSc educational exemption, with
medium-of-instruction evidence. Because the page says completed and the timeline says English qualifications
must be passed by January 15, the pending UChicago degree is NOT a confirmed waiver route for a senior-year
application. Ask admissions before relying on it, or obtain a valid test by the deadline. PhD does not state an
automatic UChicago exemption from any requested evidence. [s3] [s4] [s12]
GRE General [Standing rule]
No GRE General requirement or recommendation in the mathematics MSc requirements or GSNS PhD guide. No
public permission/weight for unsolicited scores was established. [s1] [s5] [s12]

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
MSc: official bachelor diploma if complete, current official transcript otherwise; course titles, grades, credits,
name; official grading scale with lowest passing/highest grade; current-course registration and study-abroad
records where relevant. PhD: all relevant bachelor/master diplomas and transcripts, originals plus certified
English translations unless English/Scandinavian. Explicit weighted AND unweighted GPAs for each degree,
calculated using original credits, not converted ECTS; upload calculation PDF and optional class rank. [s5] [s12]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
MSc transcript and ongoing-course documentation plus descriptions for all passed/current courses. PhD
weighted-GPA worksheet in Other information to consider; official templates accommodate35 or75 non-ECTS
courses. Distinguish bachelor and master GPA; no independent fixed20-course list. [s5] [s12]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
MSc required for all completed/current courses; official descriptions may be assembled into a document with
direct institutional URL after each, or institution-stamped/signed. Self-translation is allowed with originals
enclosed. PhD does not universally require a separate syllabus packet, though additional verification can be
requested. [s5] [s12]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
PhD minimum one reference; additional relevant references permitted. MSc ordinary mathematics checklist
lists none. [s5] [s12]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
MSc tuition waiver uses ordinary admission materials and explicitly asks for no additional documents. PhD
reference is part of the funded application. Optional official template asks relationship/duration, comparative
ratings for qualifications, maturity, creativity, motivation and intellectual potential, plus brief
evaluation/signature/date. [s11] [s12] [s15]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
PhD public guide directs applicant to gather references as PDF uploads; it does not describe automatic
invitations from entered referee details. Obtain the letter or agree a confidential alternative with GSNS before
the deadline. MSc has no ordinary referee workflow. [s5] [s12]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
PhD references are required before final application submission; the guide does not provide a post-submit
invitation process or extra deadline. [s12]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
PhD final submission generates email confirmation with applicationID; this is not a separately documented
referee-receipt dashboard. Since the public workflow uses applicant uploads, verify the attached referencePDF
before sending. MSc confirmation is in portal Messages with email notification. [s6] [s12]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
PhD explicitly permits previously obtained reference letters to be uploaded. No guaranteed post-submission
replacement control was established; late documents excluded. If duplicate applications for the same project
are submitted, GSNS may evaluate only the latest. MSc submitted content cannot be edited freely; reopening
is for requested missing documents. [s8] [s12]

Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
PhD requires updated CV covering education, experience and accomplishments; no page cap specified. MSc
ordinary mathematics checklist has no CV requirement; live form may ask structured biographical details. PhD
attachments PDF, maximum 20MB each category, merge multiple items per category; no ZIP. [s5] [s12]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
PhD exact short prompt: “Explain your reasons for applying.” Maximum one page. No specified font/spacing.
This motivation is distinct from the project description. No MSc mathematics SOP listed. [s1] [s5] [s12]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background essay listed for ordinary MSc or PhD. Relevant circumstances can be
addressed in PhD motivation within one page or in a specifically requested administrative explanation. [s5] [s12]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
PhD general call incorporates interests into project description and named supervisor discussion. No additional
standalone interest essay. Specific calls may instruct copying their advertised project text into the required
proposal upload; follow that call. [s12] [s17]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
PhD general call:0.5-4 pages describing project ideas and research plans; may link further information. Adviser
discussion strongly recommended but committee can match an independently proposed project. Specific-call
instructions govern its proposal upload. No MSc research proposal listed. [s5] [s12] [s17]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
GSNS may remove scientific papers, large reports and theses from uploads; provide a URL instead. If seeking
credit for earlier research, documented written evidence may be required under the specific credit-transfer
rules. No ordinary MSc thesis/sample requirement. [s5] [s12] [s14]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Include research accomplishments/publications in PhD CV where relevant; link full papers instead of uploading
large manuscripts. No separate publication-list cap or mandatory publication requirement. MSc has no listed
publication document. [s5] [s12]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
MSc full course descriptions and ongoing-course records; PhD GPA-calculationPDF with original credits. No
additional generic mathematics-course essay or bespoke form was established. [s5] [s12]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
MSc Danish state scholarship: no separate application, essay or extra upload; explicit instruction not to add
scholarship documents. PhD funding explanation asks sources/amounts of any available support; may be blank
for a specific funded call. [s11] [s12]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
PhD: desired start, credit-transfer request, financing where applicable, chosen call/project title and how you

Denmark · MSc Mathematics; flexible4+4 and post-master5+3 PhD
European research-fit addition; direct four-year US-bachelor equivalence requires individual confirmation.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• MSc requires 10ECTS programming in addition to broad mathematics.
• A four-year US bachelor does not automatically establish4+4 PhD eligibility.
• Pending UChicago degree is not a confirmed English-test exemption by January 15.
• Natural Sciences MSc scholarship is tuition only, without a living stipend.
• PhD form cannot save a partial draft; letters and all PDFs must be ready before submission.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: UChicago bachelor may qualify if equivalent to a Danish180-ECTS degree and containing60 ECTS broad
mathematics plus10 ECTS programming. Programming is a genuine separate prerequisite; do not assume the
math major alone satisfies it. PhD: current flexible4+4 route requires bachelor plus at least60 ECTS additional
master-level study; a four-year US bachelor is not automatically declared equivalent. Seek assessment of
graduate courses beyond bachelor requirements. Ordinary5+3 PhD requires master-level qualification. [s1] [s13]
[s14]
Before submission [Standing rule]
MSc: check programming and mathematical prerequisites; gather official syllabi, records, English proof and fee
receipt; rank up to three programmes. PhD: discuss project and funding with a prospective adviser, prepare
every attachment before opening the form - the PhD form cannot be saved partially for later. Separate
general-project and advertised-project applications have distinct research-description content. [s1] [s5] [s6] [s12]
[s16]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Strongly recommended for PhD general call and mathematics programme: discuss a targeted project and
available financing. Main supervisor must be permanent scientific staff at least
associate-professor/senior-researcher level. MSc does not require a prearranged thesis supervisor. Current
matches below do not imply an advertised 2027 vacancy. [s1] [s12] [s16] [s18]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
MSc DANS portal: rank up to three programmes, upload each complete file, submit and check Messages
receipt; only one offer is made and lower priorities then rejected. Request reopening for missing documents,
not email attachments. PhD: complete in one browser session, cannot save partial draft; submit all required
PDFs and retain confirmation/applicationID. [s6] [s7] [s8] [s12]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
MSc summer 2027 portal-delay notice and timeline are explicit. Tuition table is 2026-27; PhD income examples
mix 2024/2026 and undated amounts. PhD quarterly schedule is standing, with specific 2027 projects not all
announced. November 2026 round already closed. [s2] [s3] [s10] [s12] [s13] [s14] [s17]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
MSc summer 2027 non-EU: January 15, 2027, midnightCET under the current timeline; submit before 23:59 to
avoid boundary ambiguity. Portal opening was postponed from November 1 to November 5, 2026. PhD
recurring rounds: February 1, May 1, August 1 and November 1, 23:59 localCET/CEST, opening two months
before. International candidates wanting August-October start must apply by May 1 at latest (four-month lead
time), or an earlier round. Specific 2027 project availability is not yet guaranteed. [s2] [s3] [s12]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
MSc automatic Danish state tuition-waiver consideration: January 15 for summer admission; no separate
application. PhD funding is assessed with the chosen call, same deadline. November 1, 2026 round is closed;
February 1, 2027 or May 1, 2027 are standing prospective rounds suitable for later start, subject to
eligibility/project availability. [s11] [s12] [s17]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
PhD: all references must be PDF attachments in the portal before the application deadline; late documents are
expressly excluded. No grace period. MSc ordinary mathematics checklist does not request letters. [s5] [s12]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
MSc English tests or qualifying educational credentials must be passed no later than January 15; the timeline
distinguishes this from later final-bachelor documentation. PhD English evidence can be requested at any
stage of recruitment; no universal advance test-report deadline is stated. No GRE deadline. [s3] [s4] [s12]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
MSc upload academic records/course descriptions and fee receipt with application. National ID due April 1;
completed bachelor diploma due July 1 for non-EU summer entrants. Conditional offers specify missing items
and document reopening; documents cannot be emailed. PhD: complete records, proposal, CV, motivation and
references before deadline; pending master diploma sent promptly once earned if applying for post-master
entry. [s3] [s5] [s7] [s8] [s12]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
MSc standing/current timeline: accept conditional or full offer by April 1; scholarship offers can have a shorter
deadline in the letter. Tuition invoice gives individual payment deadline, generally April-May, before
residence-permit paperwork. PhD offer response date is individual; February round decisions endMarch, May
round endJune, August round endSeptember, November round earlyJanuary. [s3] [s11] [s12]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc EnglishB: IELTS6.5 overall/6 each; legacy TOEFL83/20 each; new-scale TOEFL4.5 overall/4 each;
Cambridge qualifying certificates. TOEFL/IELTS must be no more than two years old when the application portal
opens. No Duolingo/PTE, TOEFLMyBest/Essentials/ITP or IELTSOneSkillRetake. PhD expects fluent academic
English comparable to TOEFL83/IELTS6.5 and may request proof during recruitment. [s4] [s12]
UChicago English exemption [Unresolved]
A completed English-taught bachelor/master from the USA qualifies for MSc educational exemption, with
medium-of-instruction evidence. Because the page says completed and the timeline says English qualifications
must be passed by January 15, the pending UChicago degree is NOT a confirmed waiver route for a senior-year
application. Ask admissions before relying on it, or obtain a valid test by the deadline. PhD does not state an
automatic UChicago exemption from any requested evidence. [s3] [s4] [s12]
GRE General [Standing rule]
No GRE General requirement or recommendation in the mathematics MSc requirements or GSNS PhD guide. No
public permission/weight for unsolicited scores was established. [s1] [s5] [s12]

GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
No GRE Mathematics requirement or recommendation in the mathematics MSc requirements or GSNS PhD
guide. [s1] [s5] [s12]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
MSc: official bachelor diploma if complete, current official transcript otherwise; course titles, grades, credits,
name; official grading scale with lowest passing/highest grade; current-course registration and study-abroad
records where relevant. PhD: all relevant bachelor/master diplomas and transcripts, originals plus certified
English translations unless English/Scandinavian. Explicit weighted AND unweighted GPAs for each degree,
calculated using original credits, not converted ECTS; upload calculation PDF and optional class rank. [s5] [s12]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
MSc transcript and ongoing-course documentation plus descriptions for all passed/current courses. PhD
weighted-GPA worksheet in Other information to consider; official templates accommodate35 or75 non-ECTS
courses. Distinguish bachelor and master GPA; no independent fixed20-course list. [s5] [s12]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
MSc required for all completed/current courses; official descriptions may be assembled into a document with
direct institutional URL after each, or institution-stamped/signed. Self-translation is allowed with originals
enclosed. PhD does not universally require a separate syllabus packet, though additional verification can be
requested. [s5] [s12]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
PhD minimum one reference; additional relevant references permitted. MSc ordinary mathematics checklist
lists none. [s5] [s12]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
MSc tuition waiver uses ordinary admission materials and explicitly asks for no additional documents. PhD
reference is part of the funded application. Optional official template asks relationship/duration, comparative
ratings for qualifications, maturity, creativity, motivation and intellectual potential, plus brief
evaluation/signature/date. [s11] [s12] [s15]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
PhD public guide directs applicant to gather references as PDF uploads; it does not describe automatic
invitations from entered referee details. Obtain the letter or agree a confidential alternative with GSNS before
the deadline. MSc has no ordinary referee workflow. [s5] [s12]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
PhD references are required before final application submission; the guide does not provide a post-submit
invitation process or extra deadline. [s12]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
PhD final submission generates email confirmation with applicationID; this is not a separately documented
referee-receipt dashboard. Since the public workflow uses applicant uploads, verify the attached referencePDF
before sending. MSc confirmation is in portal Messages with email notification. [s6] [s12]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
PhD explicitly permits previously obtained reference letters to be uploaded. No guaranteed post-submission
replacement control was established; late documents excluded. If duplicate applications for the same project
are submitted, GSNS may evaluate only the latest. MSc submitted content cannot be edited freely; reopening
is for requested missing documents. [s8] [s12]

Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
PhD requires updated CV covering education, experience and accomplishments; no page cap specified. MSc
ordinary mathematics checklist has no CV requirement; live form may ask structured biographical details. PhD
attachments PDF, maximum 20MB each category, merge multiple items per category; no ZIP. [s5] [s12]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
PhD exact short prompt: “Explain your reasons for applying.” Maximum one page. No specified font/spacing.

No separate personal/background essay listed for ordinary MSc or PhD. Relevant circumstances can be
addressed in PhD motivation within one page or in a specifically requested administrative explanation. [s5] [s12]

PhD general call incorporates interests into project description and named supervisor discussion. No additional

Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
GSNS may remove scientific papers, large reports and theses from uploads; provide a URL instead. If seeking

rules. No ordinary MSc thesis/sample requirement. [s5] [s12] [s14]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Include research accomplishments/publications in PhD CV where relevant; link full papers instead of uploading

MSc full course descriptions and ongoing-course records; PhD GPA-calculationPDF with original credits. No

MSc Danish state scholarship: no separate application, essay or extra upload; explicit instruction not to add

International eligibility [Standing rule]
Tuition-liable non-EU applicants can receive MSc state waivers. International applicants can compete for PhD
positions, subject to qualification and funded plan. Separate ordinary Danish SU entitlement is not implied by
PhD-SU scholarship eligibility or US F-1 status. [s11] [s12] [s13]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
PhD admission depends on a complete plan covering scholarship/salary, tuition, research and mobility.
Published tuition DKK80000/year normally comes from funding. Personal/private self-funding is prohibited;
externally awarded scholarships require approval and research-freedom review. Salaried fellows normally
owe280 hours/year academic work, with one semester exempt; negotiated removal reduces pay. PartA
student-teacher employment is optional. [s12] [s13] [s14]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
MSc scholarship automatically considered with admission. PhD choose general call with own project and
funding discussion, or a specific already-funded project; each project requires its own application. Academic
eligibility alone does not secure a funded place. [s11] [s12]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Approved external foundation/EU/home-country scholarship or industrial employer support can form a doctoral
plan; international scholarship contracts are assessed for research freedom. Industrial PhD requires separate
company funding application plus GSNS conditional approval. No universally available additional 2027 award
for a new UChicago mathematics graduate was established. [s12] [s14]
Application fee [Standing rule]
MSc EUR150/DKK1125 application fee, covers up to three AU programmes; pay through webshop by deadline
and attach receipt to each. Refunded if offer accepted and still enrolled October 1 (summer) or March 1
(winter); not refunded on rejection. PhD GSNS application explicitly free. [s9] [s12]

MSc exemptions: Danish bachelor, tuition-exempt status, or living in Denmark at time of application under the
published rule. US F-1/UChicago does not itself qualify. No general need-based application waiver established.
PhD no fee, hence no waiver needed. [s9] [s12]
